visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with black-rimmed glasses and a dark olive outdoor jacket crouches in a lush green forest. He holds two thick, brown logs, one in each hand. The background consists of dense trees and foliage with soft natural lighting, creating a serene outdoor atmosphere. (2) The camera frames him from the waist up as he continues to crouch. In front of him, on the ground, sits a portable metal camping stove and a canvas gear bag. He gestures with the logs as he looks directly into the camera. (3) Close-up view of the man's hands as he strikes the two wooden logs together repeatedly. The logs are textured with rough, dark bark. Bright green leaves are visible in the soft-focus background, suggesting a park or wooded area during daylight. (4) Returning to the medium shot, the man continues to hold the logs and speaks. He shifts his weight slightly while crouching on the forest floor. The lighting is consistent and natural, illuminating his face and the outdoor camping equipment. (5) The man puts down the thick logs and picks up a long, spindly, brown tree branch. He holds it vertically with one hand initially, then moves both hands to grasp the middle of the branch for a demonstration. (6) He holds the long branch horizontally, displaying its dry, leafless texture to the viewer. He wears dark trousers and sits near a small campfire setup. The environment remains a peaceful, shaded woodland area with various plants in the distance. (7) The man uses both hands to exert pressure on the thin branch, attempting to break it. The wood bends significantly but does not snap into two pieces. His facial expression remains focused and instructional as he demonstrates the wood's flexibility. (8) He discards the first stick and picks up a different, shorter branch from the ground. He snaps it forcefully using both hands; it breaks cleanly into two pieces. He looks at the broken ends and then back at the camera. (9) He takes another segment of the branch and snaps it again with a quick, decisive hand movement. The small wood fragments are clearly visible as they fly off. He continues gesturing with the remaining pieces of dry wood. (10) The man holds several small, broken twigs in his left hand while speaking directly to the camera. He remains in the same crouching position surrounded by the natural forest floor, foliage, and his camping gear as the shot ends.
